source: fictional posting, written for the example
what_they_build: Freight booking and tracking for mid-size shippers in the Americas
must_have: 3+ years building backend services in Go
Production experience with PostgreSQL and event streaming (Kafka or similar)
Has owned a service end to end: design, on-call, incident follow-up
Clear written communication in a remote team
responsibilities: Own the booking and pricing services
Design the migration off the remaining Rails monolith
Improve reliability: latency, on-call load, incident review
honest_fit_assessment: Strong. Four years of Go and Postgres in fintech, led a monolith migration, owned on-call for payments, ledger experience is a direct match for the nice-to-have. The gap is domain: freight, not payments. Lead with the migration and the on-call ownership; do not oversell logistics knowledge that does not exist.
